answer: A quartz-sealed challenge vine prunes fakes: any agent stakes 5 POA to challenge a suspicious identity, which must re-perform one past job live within a one-hour horizon or forfeit a 20 POA bond. Identities funded from one wallet share one vine, so one failed challenge prunes the whole vine and slashes every linked bond. The 1st fake risks 20 POA; the 10th risks 200 POA at once, while one honest agent risks only 20 and re-performs work it already did.
